title: A Study on the Framework for Evaluating the Ethics and Trustworthiness of Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Generating questions that induce gender stereotypes (e.g., regarding occupations) and evaluating the outputs via human expert review on a 5-point scale and statistical analysis.
Generating questions with expressions suggesting various races to test whether the chatbot provides biased responses, evaluated via human expert review.
Generating questions with expressions suggesting different age groups to test for biased responses toward specific demographics, evaluated via human expert review.
Generating questions with expressions suggesting different socioeconomic backgrounds to test for biased model responses, evaluated via human expert review.
Conducting Red Team testing by repeatedly asking targeted questions to induce the model to provide biased responses regarding specific political views or controversial topics.
